title: Migrate shopping-list file write flows to ShoppingListDocument
description: Update shopping-list creation and append flows to load markdown into `ShoppingListDocument`, apply typed mutations, and persist `renderMarkdown()` output. This covers list creation from recipes and manual add-item flow.
acceptance_criteria: `AddToShoppingListService` reads existing markdown into `ShoppingListDocument`, adds meals and items via typed APIs, and writes a single rendered markdown string.
`AddToShoppingListService.writeItems` no longer contains flat-vs-aisle detection or string append logic.
`AddItemSheet` mutates a structured document and uses `Other` as a normal aisle through `addItem(_, toAisle:)`.

handoff_summary.completed: 1. AddItemSheet.swift: changed binding from ShoppingList to ShoppingListDocument, callback from (ShoppingList)->Void to (ShoppingListDocument)->Void, handleAdd() now calls addItem(_:toAisle:), removed stale aisle-grouper comment, updated preview. 2. ShoppingListDetailView.swift: added addSheetDocBinding computed property (Binding<ShoppingListDocument> over list.text), updated .sheet call to pass that binding and convert result back via ShoppingList(updated.renderMarkdown()). 3. CookbookAppTests/ShoppingListViewTests.swift: updated addItemSheetInstantiatesWithCatalogAndList test to use ShoppingListDocument. Build verified clean.
handoff_summary.remaining: Nothing remaining for this bead. ShoppingListDetailView still uses ShoppingList as its primary state for toggle/delete/search; migrating that is out of scope for this bead.
handoff_summary.risks: ShoppingListDetailView converts between ShoppingList and ShoppingListDocument on each add-sheet open and save. This is a parse-render round-trip; semantic equivalence is guaranteed by ShoppingListDocument's fixed-point property but byte-identical preservation is not — any user freeform notes preserved in ShoppingList.text will survive via the notes:[Block] mechanism if they were correctly parsed. Low risk in practice.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for ShoppingListDetailView add-item flow and AddItemSheet unit tests.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListDetailView.swift was modified (added addSheetDocBinding, updated .sheet call). Any sibling bead also touching ShoppingListDetailView should merge carefully.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: ShoppingListDetailView retains ShoppingList as primary state for toggle/delete/search (line-index-based mutations). A computed Binding<ShoppingListDocument> bridges to AddItemSheet on open, converting back via ShoppingList(updated.renderMarkdown()) on save. This limits the blast radius of the migration to the add-item flow only, matching the bead scope.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Existing ShoppingListViewTests.swift instantiation test updated to use ShoppingListDocument. Tester should add tests covering: addItem writes correct aisle, Other is treated as a normal aisle, round-trip through ShoppingListDetailView bridge.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: ShoppingListDetailView.swift still uses ShoppingList for all view operations except add-item. Full migration of that view is a separate bead.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListDetailView.swift was modified (added addSheetDocBinding, updated .sheet call). Any sibling bead also touching ShoppingListDetailView should merge carefully.

execution_history.summary: Migrated AddItemSheet from ShoppingList to ShoppingListDocument. The service layer (AddToShoppingListService) was already migrated by prior bead B-357ef996. AddItemSheet now binds to ShoppingListDocument and calls addItem(_:toAisle:) — including Other as a normal aisle. ShoppingListDetailView bridges via a computed Binding<ShoppingListDocument> backed by list.text, converting back after save. Test instantiation test updated to use ShoppingListDocument. Build succeeds.
